description.content: Manage business locations

Retrieves detailed location profiles, providing comprehensive data that extends beyond just basic location attributes within the Business Listing Solution. You can use this endpoint to access an array of information about specific profiles.
Note: The Get Locations and Get Location endpoints are designed to retrieve only cleansed profiles. If you attempt to fetch an unmanaged profile using either endpoint, the response will result in a null value.

This endpoint facilitates a faceted profile search of the platform, providing aggregated counts of profiles based on specified criteria. Rather than returning individual profile data, this endpoint groups profiles based on a selected attribute (such as phoneType, gender, etc.) and returns a count of profiles for each distinct value within that attribute.
